note: Small private campground on Peterson Lake south of Iron River, reached by about 1.5 miles of hilly gravel road through the woods. Many sites are held by longer-stay campers; no website or posted rate, so call ahead. The property has been listed for sale since August 2024. --Claude
summary: Operating in 2025 (chamber: 'CLOSED FOR THE SEASON - as of 10/24/25 Check back in the Spring for reservations!'), but no operator website (stored WACO page now 404), no posted rate (RV Life camper 7/2024 $30), property for sale since 8/2024 'with the option of continuing the Wildwood Campground'. 25 sites (18 W/E, 5 FHU, 2 none). Many sites long-stay (review). Google 4.6 (27). DROP CANDIDATE (mostly seasonal + iffy) - reviewer call.
